dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, would you mind printing this document for me?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ˈprɪntɪŋ ðɪs ˈdɑːkjəmənt fər miː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, not at all. Do you need it now?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈnɑːt ət ˈɔːl. duː juː ˈniːd ɪt ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, please. And would you mind making two photocopies?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. ənd wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈtuː ˈfoʊtoʊkɑːpiz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Should I scan it, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ʃʊd aɪ ˈskæn ɪt, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good idea. Then would you mind sending the file to Kate?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈðɛn wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ˈsɛndɪŋ ðə ˈfaɪl tə ˈkeɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No problem. What's her email address?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. ˈwʌts hɜːr ˈiːmeɪl ˈædrɛs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's on the list on my desk. Oh, and would you mind turning off the air conditioning? It's freezing in here!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ɑːn ðə ˈlɪst ɑːn maɪ ˈdɛsk. ˈoʊ, ənd wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ˈtɜːrnɪŋ ˈɔːf ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ? ɪts ˈfriːzɪŋ ɪn ˈhɪr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not at all. Do you need anything else?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ət ˈɔːl. duː juː ˈniːd ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, that's all. Thanks, Nam. You're very helpful.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðæts ˈɔːl. ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. jʊr ˈvɛri ˈhɛlpfəl.
